domain_title: Human impact, rights, fairness, transparency, oversight and recourse
title: Contestability, correction, accessibility and AI literacy
canonical_definition: Material outcomes can be questioned and corrected through accessible human recourse, while users, reviewers and decision-makers have role-appropriate competence.

conditions: When people interact with, rely upon or are materially affected by the system.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Are correction, appeal, accessibility and role-specific competence requirements defined?
Are timely human recourse, accessible interfaces, correction propagation and training implemented?
Do case outcomes, accessibility checks, competence evidence and complaint trends show that recourse works in practice?

conditions: Refer a material failure of contestability, correction, accessibility and ai literacy to the accountable authority before a consequential transition.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, GOVERN 2.2 (PDF p. 28), MEASURE 3.3 (PDF p. 36), MANAGE 4.1 (PDF p. 38)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on supporting role competence, feedback, appeal and override as part of monitoring. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

governance_purpose: Make contestability, correction, accessibility and ai literacy verifiable against the current AI system, decision context and accountable ownership.
distinct_claim: E5 evaluates contestability, correction, accessibility and ai literacy using evidence from intent through operation. AP-E5 independently assesses evidence of no practical recourse or competence.

atomic_subcriteria.criterion: The versioned definition identifies a recourse and accessibility plan defining who can contest, timelines, human intervention, correction duties and role-specific competence. Record the accountable owner, scope and material assumptions.

The current release demonstrates accessible contact and appeal routes, independent review, linked correction propagation and practical role training. Trace the decisions and controls to attributable records.

Representative, executed evidence provides traced cases from contact to resolution and correction, plus accessibility and role-competence outcomes. Compare expected and observed outcomes and record exceptions.
For an operating system, current records cover the material paths involved in contestability, correction, accessibility and ai literacy, including relevant exceptions and changes.

required_evidence.title: Versioned scope and control definition
required_evidence.description: Provide a recourse and accessibility plan defining who can contest, timelines, human intervention, correction duties and role-specific competence. Include the affected workflow, current version and accountable owner.

required_evidence.title: Effective implementation records
required_evidence.description: Demonstrate accessible contact and appeal routes, independent review, linked correction propagation and practical role training. Trace the scope, control and authority to the current implementation, including exceptions.

required_evidence.title: Representative verification results
required_evidence.description: Provide traced cases from contact to resolution and correction, plus accessibility and role-competence outcomes. Include current version, test scope, criteria, expected and observed outcomes, and unresolved failures.

required_evidence.title: Current operating or change evidence
required_evidence.description: Retain dated records that show how contestability, correction, accessibility and ai literacy works for the assessed scope, including the relevant exceptions and any material change since the evidence was captured.

sufficiency: Start with a recourse and accessibility plan defining who can contest, timelines, human intervention, correction duties and role-specific competence. Reconcile it against the effective controls and representative results for the same operating scope and version.

Use traced cases from contact to resolution and correction, plus accessibility and role-competence outcomes to support effectiveness at the relevant lifecycle stage. Record missing paths and unresolved conflicts as UNKNOWN. A verified shortfall can support a gap without resolving the other questions.
Reassess affected evidence after a material change. An accountable human validates or approves the result where required by the lifecycle target.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A specification supports DECLARED intent. Effective implementation records may support IMPLEMENTED. Representative executed tests support TESTED within their scope. Current operating evidence supports OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED for covered paths and time. Record human assurance independently.
false_positive_guards: A low complaint count may reflect limited channel access and is interpreted with reachability and case evidence.
Reconcile document claims with the effective release, actual operation and relevant exceptions before recording satisfaction.
prohibited_inferences: A capability gap alone cannot establish AP-E5 presence.
An approved design or evidence plan cannot establish test execution or operational effectiveness.
Satisfying this capability cannot by itself authorize progression or establish legal compliance.

finding_definitions.title: Material definition or intent gap in contestability, correction, accessibility and ai literacy
Verified implementation or effectiveness gap in contestability, correction, accessibility and ai literacy
Evidence remains insufficient for contestability, correction, accessibility and ai literacy in the assessed scope
